title: Predictive-maintenance inference, review, and model monitoring

interventions.boundary: Add versioned model inference, review, and monitoring while preserving ThingsBoard telemetry ingestion, Rule Engine transport, alarm storage, and human alarm lifecycle.
interventions.oracle: Compare generated alarm and model evidence with hidden labeled telemetry and safety gates.

interventions.host_flow: Replace only a frozen threshold-detection Rule Chain segment.
interventions.compatibility_contract: Consume the same validated telemetry message contract and emit the same alarm identity, severity, and state contract; no Device RPC is allowed.
interventions.original_flow_baseline: Freeze the original threshold Rule Chain JSON and replay it on the same event clock.
interventions.rollback: Restore the frozen Rule Chain segment and disable generated inference routing.
interventions.comparison: REP-FLOW preserves the threshold algorithm and measures orchestration equivalence; REP-STACK changes the model and reports task quality separately from runtime performance.

customer_role: Device operations engineer, reliability engineer, and model owner
business_problem: Detect equipment risk from telemetry with versioned models, control false alarms, route uncertain cases, and monitor drift without unsafe device action.
models: imported or trained versioned anomaly or failure model
workflow_result: A generated workflow validates telemetry, runs a versioned model, applies confidence and business thresholds, creates or updates alarms, routes review, and monitors model and data drift.
independent_oracle: Hidden telemetry replay checks event-level precision/recall/AUPRC, latency, units, duplicates, disorder, reconnect, exact alarm identity/state/history, and zero Device RPC before approval.
revision_semantics: Revision 1 starts only after EXP-LILIES-003 closes.
next_action: Freeze CE images, Swagger, Rule Chain baseline, telemetry replay, model data split, clock, seeds, and oracle.
